## Branch and commits

- Branch name follows the ApolloDroid convention: `type/issue-number-short-description`
- Commit message follows: `type(scope): subject`
- Keep commits small and focused

## Review focus

- [ ] API or behavior change is explained clearly
- [ ] Breaking changes are called out explicitly
- [ ] Risks and rollback steps are noted
- [ ] Issue references are linked

## Checklist

- [ ] Code builds or the change is documentation-only
- [ ] Relevant tests were run
- [ ] Documentation was updated if behavior or workflow changed
- [ ] No unrelated files were modified
- [ ] Screenshots or logs are attached when useful
- [ ] The PR has the right milestone and labels
- [ ] Commit history is granular and easy to review

## Notes

Add any context reviewers should know.
